title: Head of the Department – Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology)

rows.text: Assoc. Professor & HOD of EEVT Department
VLSI Design, Low power VLSI, FPGA Debugging and Signal Processing

Dr. Murali Anumothu has received Doctoral Degree in VLSI Design from K L University, Andhra Pradesh. He has completed two post-graduate degrees—one in Microelectronics and VLSI Design from IIT Madras and another in Embedded Systems from JNTU Hyderabad and also received B.Tech degree in ECE from Acharya Nagarjuna University. He is currently working as Associate Professor and Head, Department of Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) in QIS College of Engineering and Technology (Autonomus), Ongole, Andhra Pradesh, India. Prior to join here, He have accumulated over 15 years of experience in teaching, research, industry, and leadership positions. Throughout his professional journey, He has published and presented in many refereed International journals and International conference proceedings. Additionally, He has authored Five textbooks, two book chapters, and published 7 patents. Moreover He achieved the All India 18th Rank in GATE-2007 and have been ratified as an Assistant and Associate Professor from JNTU Kakinada and also he is a Research supervisor under JNTU Kakinada. His area of interests includes VLSI Design, Low power VLSI, FPGA Debugging and Signal Processing, He is a member of IEEE, IAENG, UACEE, IFERP, LMInSc.
